name: New London Barn Playhouse Summer Camps
description_short: Weekly theater day camps from the New London Barn Playhouse, held at the New London Historical Society. Each week has a theme such as dance, backstage design or filmmaking, with groups for ages 6 to 8 and 9 to 11 and a short showcase on Friday.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds must be requested two weeks before the first day of camp. Partial or full refunds may be offered in an emergency.

sessions.name: Halloween in July week (title not shown on the page)
Barn Academy: Jack and the Beanstalk (ages 6 to 11 together)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 summer camps, 9:00 to 4:00, Barnie Buddies ages 6 to 8 and Main Street Players ages 9 to 11, all weeks at the New London Historical Society; campers bring a sack lunch; tuition assistance at any level; staff walk students from KRES-NL or drive them on request; zip is the Playhouse's own (84 Main Street, New London, NH 03257)
